item.title: BTC/ZNN swaps over HTLC with a Taproot leg
item.body:
Atomic BTC/ZNN and BTC/ZTS swaps on the HTLC contract mainnet already has, with a Taproot
output on the Bitcoin side, usable from an ordinary wallet (roadmap M4a).

- Swap client with both roles, refund and crash recovery
- Taproot HTLC output and its three spends on the Bitcoin side
- Point-lock and key-lock types inside `htlc`, which need a spork; the hash-lock swap does not
item.author: dev-ada
